class.name: FmodAudioEffectPanner
class.brief_description: Stereo panner for positioning audio in the stereo field.
class.description: FmodAudioEffectPanner uses a custom DSP to distribute the first two input channels between the left and right output channels. Additional channels pass through unchanged. A pan value of 0.0 preserves the original left and right signals. Negative values move the signal toward the left output, while positive values move it toward the right output. Stereo input is not summed to mono at the center position. This effect simulates Godot's AudioEffectPanner and provides a simple way to spatialize mono or stereo audio in a 2D stereo soundstage.

members.member: The pan position, clamped to -1.0 through 1.0. The default 0.0 preserves the input stereo image. At -1.0 the two input channels are summed into the left output, and at 1.0 they are summed into the right output.
